title: COSMO: Cancer Ontology Supervised Multimodal Orchestration (code, v1.0)
description: Code, Stage I language model weights, concept embeddings and Stage II adapter weights for COSMO, a knowledge-guided framework for subtyping common and rare brain, lung and kidney cancers from whole-slide images. Archived release of https://github.com/hms-dbmi/COSMO accompanying the manuscript 'Biomedical Knowledge-Enhanced Multimodal Learning for Common and Rare Cancer Pathology Diagnosis - A Multi-Center Validation Study'.
